verdict.rationale: Homebrew's Brewfile format is a plain-text, human-readable snapshot of installed formulae/casks/taps, and `brew bundle dump` exports the full installed-state to this open format, which can be checked into a repo like package.json — giving users a portable, non-proprietary record of their setup they can take elsewhere. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that a dumped Brewfile fully round-trips all package types and settings, and no documentation of a clean 'uninstall everything and take your data' migration path beyond the Brewfile itself.
